chunks: Whatever is in it from Marwan ibn Muslim, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Muhammad ibn Yahya al-'Attar, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ali ibn Ya'qub al-Hashimi, from Marwan ibn Muslim.

key_terms.الْعَطَّارِ: Al-'Attar; the descriptive nisbah of Muhammad ibn Yahya in the chain.
key_terms.الْهَاشِمِيِّ: Al-Hashimi; the family nisbah of Ali ibn Ya'qub in the chain.
key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: May Allah be pleased with him; an honorific supplication used here for the author's father.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Marwan ibn Muslim in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage gives the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Marwan ibn Muslim in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih. Its significance lies in documenting the route of transmission, which is essential in hadith sciences for tracing and evaluating narrated reports.
